description: UC Berkeley — strong OOS applicant, RD
rationale: UCB anchor ~Tier-1 band. The 2026-05-31 audit removed CA from the flat ×0.5 OOS penalty (UCs admit OOS easier, #312); UCB OOS now uses its published data (OOS 7.3% / overall 11% = ×0.66) instead of a guess. Strong-profile band × 0.66 ≈ 0.21. Range [0.1, 0.26] reflects the data-grounded OOS window (still a reach).
